_meta.description: Score a two-item battery per row with ATTR_SCALE_SCORE on experiment.pulse, averaged per treatment arm. The named vector spend (revenue_before, revenue; labels before / after) declares kind scale with scale_min 0 and scale_max 400. spend_mean is the mean of the valid items with min_valid defaulting to both: the few rows holding a value above 400 read that value as missing (never clamped), so they score null, and the run carries one PULSE_ATTR_SCALE_OUT_OF_RANGE warning with n_out_of_range. spend_keyed reverse-keys the item labelled before (scored 0 + 400 - x on the vector's declared range) and needs only one valid item. spend_total reads the same columns as inline fields with no declared range (no range check) and stat sum: the PRORATED sum, the valid-item mean times the item count, so a skipped item never reads as 0. Row-local, single pass and streamable; the weight is irrelevant.
_meta.name: attr_scale_score
